content.value_statement: Mobile teams must balance platform quality, shared code, and release complexity. This skill guides architecture, implementation, testing, and deployment for React Native, Flutter, iOS, and Android apps.
actual_capabilities: Designs React Native, Flutter, and native iOS or Android app architectures.
Plans offline-first data sync, caching, conflict handling, and local storage.
Recommends mobile performance, battery, memory, and startup optimizations.
Guides native integrations for biometrics, cameras, payments, maps, and notifications.
Defines testing and CI/CD workflows for app store release pipelines.
Reviews app store optimization, privacy labels, and deployment readiness.
limitations: Does not provide live device testing or emulator execution by itself.
Cannot replace official App Store or Google Play review decisions.
Requires project context, platform targets, and constraints for precise implementation advice.
May need framework-specific docs for the newest SDK changes.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Mobile App
use_cases.description: Choose React Native, Flutter, or native development based on product goals, team skills, and platform requirements.

use_cases.title: Modernize an Existing App
use_cases.description: Map migrations for React Native architecture updates, Flutter rendering changes, or native module improvements.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Store Release
use_cases.description: Review testing, signing, privacy disclosure, app store metadata, and deployment workflow readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Scope a Mobile Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a mobile feature for [platforms]. The feature is [feature]. Include architecture, data flow, testing, and release risks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare React Native, Flutter, and native options for [app type]. Consider team skills, offline needs, native integrations, performance, and release cost.

prompt_templates.title: Improve App Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this mobile performance problem: [symptoms]. Suggest likely causes, profiling steps, quick wins, and long-term fixes for iOS and Android.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Release Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CI/CD and app store release workflow for [framework]. Include signing, testing, beta distribution, monitoring, rollback, and compliance checks.

output_examples.input: Plan a React Native commerce app with offline cart support.
output: Recommends a modular React Native architecture with shared domain logic and platform-specific payment handling.
Defines local storage, sync conflict rules, API caching, and test coverage for checkout reliability.
Calls out release risks for privacy disclosures, payment review, and device testing.

output_examples.input: Optimize a Flutter app with slow animations and high memory use.
output: Prioritizes profiling for frame timing, rebuild frequency, image cache size, and list virtualization.
Suggests targeted changes for rendering, state management, asset loading, and memory leak checks.
Adds validation steps for older devices and both mobile platforms.

output_examples.input: Prepare an Android and iOS release pipeline.
output: Outlines build signing, automated tests, beta distribution, release approvals, and store submission steps.
Includes monitoring, crash reporting, rollback planning, and privacy checklist items.

best_practices: Share platform requirements, target devices, user flows, and release constraints before asking for architecture choices.
Ask for testing, accessibility, security, and deployment checks with each implementation plan.
Validate suggestions against official framework and store documentation before release.
anti_patterns: Asking for a complete app without explaining platforms, data needs, or team skills.
Ignoring platform-specific design rules when reusing cross-platform components.
Shipping mobile changes without device testing, performance checks, or store compliance review.

faq.question: Which mobile frameworks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports React Native, Flutter, native iOS, native Android, Expo, Ionic, and related mobile tooling.

faq.question: Can it help choose between React Native and Flutter?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare platform fit, team skills, performance needs, native integrations, and release costs.

faq.question: Does it generate complete mobile applications?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation and produce plans or examples, but final app quality depends on project code and testing.

faq.question: Can it help with app store release work?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers signing, beta testing, screenshots, metadata, privacy labels, monitoring, and release readiness.

faq.question: Does it cover offline-first mobile apps?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan local storage, sync queues, conflict resolution, caching, and background synchronization.

faq.question: Is this skill useful for security-sensitive apps?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes mobile security topics such as secure storage, biometrics, network security, and compliance checks.
